$comment: AUTHORITY for the JSON-RPC error codes the launcher's control API answers with (contract/LAUNCHER-CONTROL.md). A request-cases.json answer's code is one of these. An answer under a code that a control code of errors/codes.json names as its `rpc` carries that code in its data, retryable as that code is; an answer under a code with `data` carries that data; an answer under any other code carries none.

codes.name: parse-error
codes.docs: The line is not JSON, or holds more than one JSON value. Answered under a null id (F2).

codes.name: invalid-request
codes.docs: The message is a batch, does not state `"jsonrpc": "2.0"` and a method, has a member JSON-RPC does not define, or its id is null, a fraction or one in flight. Answered under a null id (F2, F3).

codes.name: method-not-found
codes.docs: The API has no method of the request's name (F4).

codes.name: invalid-params
codes.docs: The request's params are not what its method's schema admits, or are written to a version of the API this launcher does not speak (V1, P1).

codes.name: internal-error
codes.docs: The launcher would send a result or error data that does not hold to its schema, or the handler panicked. Never retryable: the same request fails the same way (E4).

codes.name: operation-failed
codes.docs: The operation the request ran failed. The data's code says why, and whether the request is retryable (E2).
